items.name: Hackathon-Diablos
items.description: El 2026 ISAC Hackathon, presentado por los Diablos Rojos, exige construir un sistema de evaluación de pitcheo calibrado específicamente para las condiciones físicas extremas de la Liga Mexicana de Béisbol (LMB).

items.description: Stuff+ ajustado por altitud para los Diablos Rojos del México · Hackathon ISAC 2026

items.name: Adenomas_Project_Hackathon
items.description: A multi omics project exploring microbiome and metabolome signals in colorectal adenoma stool samples. The results were mostly weak, but the workflow includes preprocessing, differential analysis, prediction models, and DIABLO visualization.

items.name: vikinghacks
items.description: This is the official website of Viking Hacks, the collegiate hackathon held at Diablo Valley College by Google Developers Student Club. This repository serves to contain the source code of the website
